title: Screenshots
description: Explore every detail of Hero Budget. Designed with love to make managing your money a simple, elegant and powerful experience.

screenshots.title: Authentication
screenshots.description: Multiple authentication and registration systems, use your email, Google account or sign in with Apple.

screenshots.title: Record movements
screenshots.description: Record new income, expenses and recurring bills to stay up to date with your financial control.

screenshots.title: Categorize each movement
screenshots.description: Create categories and assign them to each movement to control the flow of your economy by categories.

screenshots.title: Analysis and charts
screenshots.description: Visualize your spending patterns with intuitive graphs and detailed analysis of your financial behavior.

screenshots.title: Smart budgets
screenshots.description: Create personalized budgets and receive alerts when you approach your spending limits.

screenshots.title: Detailed reports
screenshots.description: Generate complete reports of your finances with PDF export and trend analysis.

screenshots.title: Complete history
screenshots.description: Access your entire financial history with advanced filters and intelligent search.

screenshots.title: Savings goals
screenshots.description: Set realistic savings goals and track your progress with visual motivation.

screenshots.title: Complete settings
screenshots.description: Fully customize the application with advanced settings and preferences.

screenshots.title: Intuitive dashboard
screenshots.description: Main panel with all your financial information organized in a clear and accessible way.
